vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species rattus_norvegicus --assembly GRCr8 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite [--tab|--vcf|--json]
fasta: the three sequences the records and the pruned cache's transcripts sit on (12, MT and the unplaced scaffold JAXUCZ010000075.1) at their full length from Rattus_norvegicus.GRCr8.dna.primary_assembly.12.fa, Rattus_norvegicus.GRCr8.dna.primary_assembly.MT.fa and Rattus_norvegicus.GRCr8.dna.nonchromosomal.fa of Ensembl release 116, each file held to its line of that directory's CHECKSUMS, every base outside the regions a run reads (each cached transcript's span with 5,000 bases of flank and each record with 2,000) masked to N; reference.fa.gz beside this file, compressed with bgzip, with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form; Ensembl VEP received the decompressed file as --fasta on every run recorded here
input: variants.vcf: 316 records, 285 on chromosome 12, 29 on the mitochondrion and 2 on the unplaced scaffold JAXUCZ010000075.1; 42 of them name their sequence by a synonym of the cache (CM070402.1 and NC_086030.1 for 12, X14848 and AC_000022.2 for MT). 309 are seeded records of tools/vep-seeded-variants (generator version 2, seed 1, 100 records a category on the three sequences, every reference allele read from the genome sequence), their IDs naming the category and its ordinal: a start codon, a gained stop and a lost stop under each genetic code and a codon that code table 2 reads differently on the mitochondrion, a missense and a synonymous change on each strand, a splice donor and an acceptor, both untranslated regions, an intron, upstream, downstream and intergenic positions, a frameshift insertion, a frameshift deletion and an in-frame deletion, the first and the last base of a sequence, and records named by a synonym. The cache calls no sequence circular, so no record crosses an origin. 7 are known variants of the cache, their IDs the rs identifiers, from 300 single-base substitutions sampled under the same seed from the cache's variation files of the three sequences. Nine exemplars per consequence-set combination the two references show, stratified by variant class and strand, 27 per combination carrying a protein-level term, plus the records the manifest's included_records name: the first record of every category of the seeded records that has a row in the reference, and the first two of each category of a genetic code

generator: tools/vep-seeded-variants --seed 1 --records wide --per-category 100 --fasta <genome sequence> --sequence MT --sequence 12 --sequence JAXUCZ010000075.1 over the cache tools/vep-storable-to-json converts from the Ensembl VEP 116 GRCr8 cache, and the sampled known variants; Ensembl VEP over the two inputs under the corpus flags; tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 116 --assembly GRCr8 --species rattus_norvegicus --dataset wide=<reference>=<the seeded records> --dataset known=<reference>=<the known variants> --k 9 --seed 1 --max-span 1000000 --max-records 500 --cache <converted cache> --flank 5000 --focus-term <frameshift_variant, inframe_deletion, inframe_insertion, protein_altering_variant, start_lost, start_retained_variant, stop_lost, stop_retained_variant, stop_gained, missense_variant, synonymous_variant, incomplete_terminal_codon_variant> --focus-k 27 --include <the named records> --covers species-rat-grcr8 --covers genetic-code-tables --fasta-name reference.fa.gz; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_function_predictions --drop-except <the transcripts on which a record changes one residue, the rows SIFT scores> --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 --variations <converted cache>/variations over the whole converted cache (protein features kept for the DOMAINS column of the everything set; the variation slices hold the known variants within one base of a record); scripts/fixtures/cut_plugin_regions.py --reference <genome sequence> --flank 5000 --record-flank 2000 over the records under the cache's own sequence names; tools/vep-golden-corpus flag-set (everything, hgvs-sift); scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus --no-stats for the manifest's run and each flag set; tools/vep-golden-corpus classify (the manifest's run and both flag sets, --field HGVSc --field HGVSp --field HGVS_OFFSET for the everything set and those with --field SIFT for the hgvs-sift set)

pruned_cache.variation_slices: the known variants within one base of a record under variations/<chr>/all_vars.gz with its .csi, as the Ensembl VEP cache lays them out: 14 on chromosome 12; the mitochondrion and the scaffold carry the empty indexed file
